segments.label: Seongsu Station to the east end of Yeonmujang-gil (pedestrian router on OSM streets)
Yeonmujang-gil, the main street of the warehouse district (OSM street geometry)
Yeonmujang 5-gil, the lane of pop-up shops (OSM street geometry)
Atelier-gil lanes of workshops and showrooms, then west to the Seoul Forest street (pedestrian router; OpenStreetMap has no street named Atelier-gil, so this leg follows the nearest streets)

pins.name: Start – Seongsu Station, line 2 (성수역 2호선)
pins.desc: Exit 3 for the warehouse streets; the Musinsa and Daelim Changgo corner is two minutes south-east. Open toilets at the station.

pins.name: Daelim Changgo Gallery (성수동대림창고갤러리)
pins.desc: The 1970s factory warehouse turned gallery café that started Seongsu's café boom; the red brick and tin ceilings are the classic photo.

pins.name: Musinsa Store Seongsu (무신사 스토어 성수)
pins.desc: Korea's biggest streetwear shop in a converted brick warehouse, with pop-up floors and a café.

pins.name: Ader Error Seongsu Space (아더에러 성수 스페이스)
pins.desc: The design brand's concept store in an old factory: art installations as much as clothes.

pins.name: Point of View Seoul – stationery on Yeonmujang-gil 18 (POINT of VIEW SEOUL)
pins.desc: Three floors of notebooks, pens, objects and a café; the best-known stationery shop in the district.

pins.name: Letter Room Seongsu – stationery (글월 Letter Room 성수점)
pins.desc: Stationery and letter-writing shop on Yeonmujang 17-gil, a few minutes east.

pins.name: Dior Seongsu – pop-up space (디올 성수)
pins.desc: The house's Seongsu space on Yeonmujang 5-gil, with changing themed events. Pop-up spaces change every few weeks: check the brand's Instagram for the current event before you queue.

pins.name: Lush Seongsu Pop-up Theatre (러쉬 성수 팝업씨어터)
pins.desc: Immersive bath-product pop-up with its own theatre rooms. Pop-up spaces change every few weeks: check the brand's Instagram for the current event before you queue.

pins.name: Frika Seongsu pop-up (프리카 성수 팝업)
pins.desc: One of the long-running pop-up spaces near Daelim Changgo. Pop-up spaces change every few weeks: check the brand's Instagram for the current event before you queue.

pins.name: Shin Ramyun Bunsik – The Factory pop-up (신라면분식 더 팩토리)
pins.desc: Brand food pop-up themed on a Korean snack bar; queues at weekends. Pop-up spaces change every few weeks: check the brand's Instagram for the current event before you queue.

pins.name: Human Made Seoul, café by Blue Bottle Coffee (휴먼 메이드 서울 카페 바이 블루보틀 커피)
pins.desc: Japanese streetwear shop with a Blue Bottle café upstairs, on Seongsu-i-ro 7-gil.

pins.name: Blue Bottle Seongsu – the first Korean shop (블루보틀 성수 카페)
pins.desc: The first Blue Bottle in Korea, in an old auto-repair garage near the Seoul Forest end; very busy at weekends.

pins.name: Seoul Forest (서울숲)
pins.desc: The big park a few minutes west: deer paddock, lawns, a flower garden and the river path; the quiet end of the walk.

pins.name: Toilet – Seongsu Station (성수역 화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet in the line 2 station, at the start of the walk.

pins.name: Toilet – Seoul Forest Station (서울숲역 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet at the station at the west end of Seoulsup-gil.

pins.name: Toilet – Seoul Forest park (서울숲공원화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet in the park by the Seoul Forest Station entrance.

pins.name: Toilet – Seoul Forest playground (숲속놀이터 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet at the children's forest playground.

pins.name: Toilet – Seoul Forest north (서울숲화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet at the north side of the park.

pins.name: Onion Seongsu – bakery café in a factory (어니언 성수)
pins.desc: The famous bakery café in an old factory building on Achasan-ro 9-gil: pandoro and sweet bread, high ceilings, queues at weekends. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Jayeondo Salt Bread Seongsu (자연도소금빵in 성수)
pins.desc: The salt-bread bakery that draws the queues near Yeonmujang-gil. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Seongsu Ciabatta (성수르치아바타)
pins.desc: Ciabatta sandwiches and bread, popular for takeaway on the lane. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Hearts Bakery Seongsu (하츠베이커리 성수점)
pins.desc: Bakery café on the Yeonmujang lanes. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Etre Bake House (에트레베이크하우스)
pins.desc: Bakery with a busy counter near the pop-up lane. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Bekerin Seongsu – bakery (베커린 성수점)
pins.desc: Bakery café near Daelim Changgo. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Hanjeongseon – café (한정선)
pins.desc: A well-reviewed Seongsu café on the Yeonmujang lanes. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Low Coffee Stand – Seoulsup-gil (로우커피스탠드)
pins.desc: The small takeaway coffee stand on the Seoul Forest street, the café you suggested. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Poset Seongsu – Seoulsup-gil (포셋 성수)
pins.desc: Neighbourhood shop-café on Seoulsup-gil 36. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Friends & Yard – brunch (프렌즈앤야드)
pins.desc: Popular brunch house at the east end of Seongsu. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: And Mill Seongsu – brunch (앤드밀 성수점)
pins.desc: Brunch and bread café near Yeonmujang 5-gil. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Rivoli Seongsu – café (리볼리 성수)
pins.desc: Sit-down café and bakery by Daelim Changgo. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Seongsu Darak – Korean restaurant (성수다락)
pins.desc: Seongsu's most reviewed Korean restaurant, in a renovated house. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Seongsu Noru – Korean (성수노루)
pins.desc: Long-running restaurant in the warehouse district. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Seongsu Kkamang – Korean (성수까망)
pins.desc: Korean restaurant with long queues on weekends. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Schedule Seongsu – brunch and dinner (스케줄 성수)
pins.desc: Western-style restaurant on the main lane. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: BD Burger Seongsu Station (bd버거 성수역연무장길 점심저녁)
pins.desc: Burger restaurant by the station, one of Seongsu's most reviewed places. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.
